name: SignOff
audience: agencies and freelancers who need clients to approve designs and documents
oneLiner: A simple way to get a clear yes or no from a client on your work.
facts: Create a temporary, secure workspace in seconds: type a project name and you get a workspace, no login.
Upload your work by drag and drop.
Send the unique secure link to your client. The client needs no login and creates no account.
The client views the files and hits "Approve" or requests changes.
Files are kept in private storage with secure, time-limited access.
Version 1.0, in public beta. Built for freelancers.
dont: Do not mention comments threads, version history, notifications, e-signatures or integrations. They are not on the fact list.
angles: chasing a client for approval over email
a client who will not make an account just to say yes
getting a clear approve or request changes before the next phase

screens.shows: The SignOff home page: "The friction-free way to get client approvals", with a box to type a project name and Start.
How it works in three steps: 1. Upload, 2. Share, 3. Approve.
